records.title: GAC: Stabilizing Asynchronous RL Training for LLMs via Gradient Alignment Control
records.reason: arXiv abstract: GAC projects stale-aligned gradients to stabilize asynchronous RL training. Its asynchronous benefit is training stability, outside inference-time serving/runtime scope.

records.title: Buffer Matters: Unleashing the Power of Off-Policy Reinforcement Learning in Large Language Model Reasoning
records.reason: arXiv abstract: BAPO improves off-policy data efficiency during RLVR post-training by replaying difficult samples; this is training data efficiency, not inference efficiency.

records.title: GeoAgent: Learning to Geolocate Everywhere with Reinforced Geographic Characteristics
records.reason: GeoAgent develops geographic datasets/rewards and RL fine-tuning for geolocation reasoning; the reported gains concern task accuracy and interpretability, not inference resource use.

records.title: P1-VL: Bridging Visual Perception and Scientific Reasoning in Physics Olympiads
records.reason: P1-VL uses curriculum RL and agentic self-verification to improve physics-olympiad reasoning. The linked VLM/serving relation is topical only; no inference-resource improvement is claimed.

records.title: RL-VLA$^3$: A Flexible and Asynchronous Reinforcement Learning Framework for VLA Training
records.reason: arXiv abstract: asynchronous framework improves reinforcement-learning training of VLA models; its system scope is training/rollout orchestration, not deployed LLM inference optimization.
